ecosystem.notes: GBV includes host earnings, service fees, cleaning fees and taxes. It is recorded when a booking is made, while revenue is recognized at check-in, so the two are timed differently. From FY2025 the 10-K pairs GBV with 'Nights and Seats Booked' (formerly 'Nights and Experiences Booked'). The 10-K does not state total host earnings, so payouts is null.
